name: Munters Group AB (publ)
summary: Munters Group AB (publ) provides climate solutions in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-pacific. The company operates through three segments: AirTech, Data Center Technologies, and FoodTech. It offers industrial and commercial dehumidification and climate control products, such as air cleaning and inlet systems, air pollution control and VOC abatement solutions, controllers and automations, coolers and humidifiers, dehumidifiers, fans, heaters, heat exchangers, mass transfer equipment, and mist eliminators.
